galleryScope: One mixed store containing all known products from both datasets; metrics remain separated by label granularity
duplicateRule: exclude query if its bytes or decoded RGB pixels equal any gallery image; report exclusions and cross-identity gallery collisions

sop.labelMeaning: eBay listing identity; not verified manufacturer SKU or independent phone capture

grocery.gallery: one iconic image and two natural train images per known fine class
grocery.queries: three official test photos per fine class
grocery.absentSelection: one deterministic sibling from every multi-class coarse group, then fill deterministically to 27
grocery.labelMeaning: official fine-grained class, sometimes produce variety rather than exact SKU

hardPairs.selection: non-overlapping nearest different product pairs from gallery embeddings only; no query scores

counterfactual: remove every reference of the true product for hard-pair queries; same frozen model and threshold
report: latency and RSS on this Mac only
limits: Public benchmark images may overlap upstream pretraining; cannot establish absence of contamination
Report sources separately: listing identities and grocery fine classes are different label granularities
No ELFBAR references or queries and no model/threshold changes
Photos and downloaded data remain outside git and production
Results rank candidates for explicit user selection, never authorize a sale or stock mutation
